name: turn-timeline
description: Adds the wall-clock range to Claude Code's turn output, so you see not just how long a turn took but from when to when. Includes a /timeline report over any past session.

show_duration.title: Include the duration in the stamp
show_duration.description: Claude Code already prints its own 'Baked for Xm Ys' line just below this one, and the two are measured at slightly different moments, so they can disagree by a second. Set false to show only the time range.

closing_line.title: Add a closing flourish
closing_line.description: Appends a short phrase such as 'still warm' or 'no notes'. Set false for just the times.
